notes.title: Patient Zero Demo is Live
notes.content: The demo is live for the public to play but you can come and join in the developer live stream action and ask your most anticipated questions to Nathan Prince the developer of the game in this unique 3 hour-long live stream for Steams Next Fest. and don't forget to wish Nathan a Happy Birthday too ;)
